description: This file defines composable UI components for bottom navigation and side navigation rails in an Android app using Jetpack Compose, including preview functions for UI testing.

classes.name: NavIcon
classes.description: A composable function that displays an icon with optional badge or error indicator based on navigation state.

methods.name: BottomBar
methods.description: A composable function that creates a bottom navigation bar with multiple items, handling selection and accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: NavigationRail
methods.description: A composable function that creates a side navigation rail with multiple items, handling selection and accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: NavIcon
methods.description: A private composable function that displays an icon with optional badge or error icon based on app update or issue status.

methods.name: Preview
methods.description: A composable function providing a UI preview with navigation rail and bottom bar.

methods.name: PreviewIssues
methods.description: A composable function providing a UI preview with issues indicated.
